chair.note: The seat is level, and its top is the lowest point of the seated body over the seat, with no shin, foot, or tail (seat_masks() of tools/blender/rig_mesh.py). The front edge lies seatGap units behind the knee joint of the bind (the property seat of the armature), so that the calf does not reach over the seat.

eyeBoxNote: The eye box holds the two loose eyeballs of the source (x 0.013 to 0.079 on the left, y 0.795 to 0.861, z 0.109 to 0.175). The nose box holds the pink nose.
bodyNote: The facts of the body (BODY_FACTS of tools/studio-body.ts) beside the height: the crease angle 180, so that each corner takes the mean normal of the faces at its vertex, as the smooth shading of an FBX viewer shows the source, and the seat width 0.46 m of the cat of main.
metersPerUnitNote: The scale of the app: H (0.228622 units) is 0.339381 m, the H of the cat of assets/models/cat/cat.rig.glb at cbc8db5e4 (0.339375 m).
jointsNote: The places are the places of the source, mapped by the paw turns and the eye edit of the hand rig (assets/models/cat/README.md). The source places are in the studio units and axes of the source pose: 1 unit from the soles to the ear tips, the soles at y = 0, +z forward, +x the left side. The right side mirrors the left side. The FBX has no armature, so each joint comes from sections of the mesh and its edge loops. Arm (closed loops of 12 vertices from x 0.111 to 0.314, axis y 0.635): the shoulder at x 0.095, at the trunk side, the elbow at x 0.20, the wrist at x 0.31, where the paw widens, the knuckles at x 0.36, the tip at x 0.41. Leg: the hip at (0.075, 0.29, 0.045), the knee at y 0.165, the ankle at y 0.06, the toe tips at z 0.155. Trunk: the spine bones lie at about 0.4 of the depth from the back. Tail: a part of the body, from its root at (0, 0.36, -0.065) back and down to its tip at (0, 0.10, -0.20). The palm is the true palm of the source: the mean normal of the paw faces that face down (x from 0.32), (0.047, -0.998, -0.039). The paw turn of the build turns it with the paw.
